name: Diplopia
overview: Diplopia is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include double vision. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
possibleCauses: In routine practice, diplopia is the simultaneous perception of two images of a single object that may be displaced in relation to each other.
In routine practice, also called double vision, it is a loss of visual focus under regular conditions, and is often voluntary.
Health professionals note that however, when occurring involuntarily, it results from impaired function of the extraocular muscles, where both eyes are still functional...
Health professionals note that problems with these muscles may be due to mechanical problems, disorders of the neuromuscular junction...
